Placing aluminium foil around potted plants: How this simple home trick works, its benefits and the right way to use it to help indoor plants thrive
articles.description: Using aluminium foil around potted plants can significantly improve light distribution and contribute to healthy growth. When strategically placed, the foil reflects light into shaded areas, promoting more vibrant plant development. Furthermore, this technique may serve to ward off certain pests, though it shouldn't be relied on as the sole pest control method. Regular care and direct sunlight access are still essential for optimal plant health.

articles.title: An apple a day, if you can pay
articles.description: In Bengaluru, families are grappling with rising fruit prices, forcing them to reconsider their grocery lists. Younger buyers, particularly, are pivoting towards more affordable options due to persistent cost fluctuations. The surge in prices is attributed to reduced market supply and direct procurement by exporters. Farmers are also struggling with adverse weather and crop diseases, complicating the situation even further, especially with the festive season looming on the horizon.

articles.description: The proposal is aimed at making foreign capital flows into equities more stable and limiting the chances of abrupt withdrawals that could put pressure on the rupee. The Union Budget 2026 retained this rate for listed shares and equity mutual funds, continuing the tax framework introduced as part of a major fiscal overhaul in 2024.

From $10T to $60T: How India is Taking Over the Global Supply Chain | Piyush Goyal
articles.description: India is opening its doors wider to the world! At The Dilli Dialogue: Policies for a Future-Ready India in New Delhi, Union Minister Piyush Goyal outlined how free trade agreements (FTAs) are expanding India's global economic opportunities. Nine FTAs covering 38 developed nations have opened access to markets representing a combined $60 trillion in GDP, compared with just $10 trillion covered by India's earlier trade agreements, according to the speaker. The strategy focuses on strengthening supply chains, boosting economic security and reducing dependence on a handful of geographies. India and its trade partners can also complement each other across sectors, from electronics and data centre equipment to textiles, footwear and food processing. With eight more trade negotiations underway, India is targeting an even bigger global opportunity. India is opening its doors wider to the world!
